name: FINAL_ASSERTION_CACHE_ONLY
retained_or_accessible_information: Frozen normalized final assertion/status cache + immutable ancestry identifiers; no sufficient statistic
replay_capability: NO independent regeneration path; cache alone fails replay if AS07 constitutive
constitutive_strength_or_relation: Strictly weaker replay challenger; evidence serving != replay

name: DIRECT_UPSTREAM_REQUERY
retained_or_accessible_information: Exact discovery predicate definition/roster + governed direct access to producer-owned same-unit facts needed to reconstruct predicate and X
followup_query_interface: Deterministic exact re-query of frozen Q
replay_capability: YES from immutable producer facts + frozen query recipe
followup_quantifier_ceiling: Q1 or QF frozen by claim; extensible only when future producer authority separately exists
constitutive_strength_or_relation: No FIELD-FORGE-local membership; exact recoverability capability

name: SUPPORT_ONLY_DISCOVERY_SUMMARY
retained_or_accessible_information: Exact predicate/profile identity + original support/status only
followup_query_interface: No external follow-up relation unless derivable from the frozen summary itself
replay_capability: YES only for original discovery support, not external relation unless lawfully derivable
constitutive_strength_or_relation: Strict information reduction from respondent-linkable forms

name: FOLLOWUP_STRATIFIED_SUMMARY
retained_or_accessible_information: Exact query-specific sufficient statistic/stratified summary for frozen predicate × X relation
followup_query_interface: Recompute frozen Q from exact summary
query_time_upstream_dependency: NO after materialization; production ancestry remains required
replay_capability: YES for the frozen Q/QF if summary is sufficient and replayable
constitutive_strength_or_relation: Claim-specific summary; cannot prove arbitrary-future capability

name: PROFILE_PREDICATE_PLUS_RESPONDENT_MEMBERSHIP_PLUS_QUERY
retained_or_accessible_information: Exact predicate/profile membership at respondent grain; only claim-needed linkage state retained
followup_query_interface: Join exact membership to frozen X/query dependency
query_time_upstream_dependency: MAY_REQUIRE_UPSTREAM_X unless X is separately included
replay_capability: YES if membership + query dependencies are immutable/replayable
followup_quantifier_ceiling: Q1/QF allowed by exact membership and lawful X availability
constitutive_strength_or_relation: Stronger linkage surface than W1/W3 in local retained membership; weaker than full state carrier

name: FULL_LOSSLESS_RESPONDENT_STATE_CARRIER_PLUS_QUERY
retained_or_accessible_information: Exact same-unit state carrier sufficient for frozen discovery + X/F + typed query logic
followup_query_interface: Direct exact query over local lossless carrier at frozen claim grain
query_time_upstream_dependency: NO for frozen included facts; producer ancestry still constitutive
replay_capability: YES from lossless carrier + provenance + query recipe
followup_quantifier_ceiling: Q1/QF included by frozen carrier; no automatic QINF
constitutive_strength_or_relation: Strongest required baseline; persistence does not add truth by itself

name: FUSION_IF_NEW_PRIMITIVE_RELATION
retained_or_accessible_information: Only if a pre-output combination creates a new primitive relation/interface not expressible as a union/composition of registered members
constitutive_strength_or_relation: Not admitted merely because combination is convenient
